observations: Whole source photograph and all five owner feedback images personally inspected. Target remains the drawn mascot on the central white package, with a broad black head, two large ears, heavy white eyes and a thin body. Owner explicitly rejects the elongated ear/tuft in v1; clean compact ears take priority over uncertain photo pixels.

V1 was explicitly rejected by owner for ears, crab-like arm gait, missing distinct pull, awkward sitting and backward jump. Its source, films and all reviews are preserved under qa/black-cat-chair-revision-2026-10-30/before. Historical agent passes do not override owner rejection.

V2 was rejected by owner for a white body gap in deep landing/recovery. Prior author and independent frame acceptance missed a torso self-intersection and are incomplete. Source96 and all v2 artifacts/reviews are preserved in qa/black-cat-body-gap-2026-10-30/before-v2. No old positive acceptance transfers to v3.

criteria.description: Two clean coherent large cat ears, no elongated horn/extra tuft; broad head and cheeky heavy eyes remain recognizable in right/front/left views.
Actual continuous shoulder-led forward/back bent-arm swing near torso, opposite the corresponding advancing leg. No crab paddling or unexplained elbows frozen at the waist; inspect a complete cycle.
Both fixed hand grips bear a distinct upward shoulder/body pull with increasing elbow flexion while rear paws still hang, BEFORE first hind lift/seat contact; then a traceable hind support/regrip.

Actual rump lowers onto seat before feet hang in front. Knees/feet read as legs; both forepaws relax down beside hips instead of a bar/akimbo. Rear supports return before standing; pelvis-only seated hold is explicit.

Rise then supported whole head/body/arm/foot turn left. One planted foot stays world fixed while the other steps; no frame mirror or instantaneous contact swap. Silhouette/toes/eyes face travel before takeoff and landing; four paws support impact then release/rise.

Actual whole torso continuously connects shoulder belt and pelvis through deep lean, landing hold, release and rise. No white slit, hourglass self-crossing, disconnected floating pelvis or lost body mass. Inspect whole silhouette and neck/hips joins with adjacent frames, not only limbs or scalars.
